svg.title: What changed at each rung
svg.desc: runs on: Build, 3 Vagrant VMs, apps under PM2; Containerize, 6 containers built from debian-slim; Orchestrate, 2-node K3s, master and agent; Go to cloud, ECS Fargate tasks in a VPC; Automate, GitLab CI on a Docker runner. way in: Build, gateway-vm on :3000; Containerize, host :3000, nothing else published; Orchestrate, NodePort 30000 to 3000; Go to cloud, an ALB, the only public resource; Automate, deploys from protected branches only. state: Build, PostgreSQL on each VM; Containerize, named volumes for both databases; Orchestrate, StatefulSets with 1Gi PVCs; Go to cloud, two RDS PostgreSQL instances; Automate, plan, approve, apply per environment. queue: Build, RabbitMQ on billing-vm; Containerize, rabbit-queue container; Orchestrate, RabbitMQ Deployment; Go to cloud, Amazon MQ, RabbitMQ engine, TLS; Automate, images pushed to the GitLab registry. secrets: Build, .env forwarded by Vagrant; Containerize, .env injected by Compose; Orchestrate, .env turned into k8s Secrets; Go to cloud, random_password into Secrets Manager; Automate, masked, protected CI variables. scaling: Build, none; PM2 restarts crashes; Containerize, restart: unless-stopped; Orchestrate, HPA 1 to 3 at 60% CPU; Go to cloud, Application Auto Scaling 1 to 3; Automate, manual approval before production
